text:
Ravi Kapoor: Heads-up: customers keep hitting inconsistent route expirations. We need a single contract for policy TTLs vs runtime enforcement so routes don't disappear mid-day.
Maya Torres: Short version: policy authors expect 'intent' semantics, runtime currently applies 'hard' semantics in some deployments. We should formalize intent fields and an enforcement policy.
Liam O'Neill: Proposal: add `intent_ttl_seconds`, `soft_deprecate_seconds`, and `enforcement_caps` negotiated at runtime startup. Runtime may clamp down (shorten) but never lengthen. Clamps must be auditable.
Sven Müller: Agree. Also add signed bundle support for private deployments. Control plane publishes signed intent bundles; local runtimes validate signatures and can operate in offline mode.
Ravi Kapoor: Important: where does prune scheduling live? Control plane (single source of truth + RBAC) or runtime-local (resilient offline)?
Maya Torres: Support both: default control-plane-managed queue, and a `local_control=true` opt-in. If control-plane present it wins. If not, local runtime uses validated bundle and its local prune queue.
Liam O'Neill: Add API `redwood route preview --policy-id` that shows what would be pruned in N days. Also a header `X-Route-Deprecation` on proxied responses during soft-deprecate window.
Sven Müller: Telemetry: emit events `route.intent_received`, `route.intent_clamped`, `route.deprecated_soft`, `route.pruned`. Fields: policy_id, route_id, declared_ttl, effective_ttl, clamp_reason, runtime_version, deployment_mode.
Ravi Kapoor: Linting rule: fail PRs that set ambiguous `ttl: 0` without `permanent: true`. For migration, runtime should log warnings and preserve legacy behavior for a grace period.
Maya Torres: Ops needs an emergency override endpoint but it must be auditable and time-limited (auto-expire in 1h). Post-mortem required for every emergency prune.
Liam O'Neill: Tests: unit tests for signed bundle verification, integration test `route-lifecycle-sim` to exercise active->soft->prune transitions and validate emitted telemetry.
Sven Müller: Docs: schema examples, migration steps, CLI commands, and onboarding notes for private customers (key rotation and bundle signing).
PolicyBot: Sample minimal schema (intent-first):
route:
  id: "beta-affinity-ap"
  match: {region: ap-south}
  intent_ttl_seconds: 1209600  # 14d
  soft_deprecate_seconds: 86400 # 1d
  metadata: {owner: "@maya", created_by: "policy-cli"}

Ravi Kapoor: Action items: Maya + Liam draft schema + linter. Sven to prototype telemetry and signed-bundle flow. Ops to draft emergency override runbook. Revisit in 4 days. :thumbsup:
